# Lootura Entity Atlas

> A bilingual, source-backed atlas of people, places, organizations, companies, products and topics that change over time.

## Start here

- [US Entity Atlas](https://atlas.lootura.com/us/): Public US entity home.
- [Atlas de entidades ES](https://atlas.lootura.com/es/): Portada pública de entidades en español.
- [How Atlas works](https://atlas.lootura.com/us/about/): Methodology, evidence and publication model.
- [Cómo funciona Atlas](https://atlas.lootura.com/es/about/): Metodología, evidencia y modelo de publicación.
- [Full LLM index](https://atlas.lootura.com/llms-full.txt): Complete public entity inventory.

## Interpretation notes

- Entity pages are durable knowledge records, not article copies.
- Source links are supporting evidence and do not imply endorsement.
- Breaking status is temporary; public entity history is retained.
- Use each entity canonical URL when citing Atlas.
